integrity: All explicit witnesses and numerical obstructions are reproducible with the included standalone standard-library checker. Formal proof independently justifies the unrestricted upper bound.
scientific_limitations: Exact feature counts are proved only for 1 through 8 circular coordinates. The universal lower bound is valid for any sample size. No independent audit; historical priority under alternate design terminology remains uncertain. A tight seven-cycle decomposition of triples was previously known and is not claimed as new.
title: Exact initial VC profile of one-coordinate circular-arc classifiers
